title: 承泽园 Chengze Yuan
subtitle: a neighbouring imperial or princely garden · outside the walls · confidence B, assumed

model.line: Massing only, not a reconstruction: 75 plain blocks (walls, houses, halls), a tinted patch of ground. Its houses, rows and halls are generated to the kind of place, not drawn from a plan of it: assumed (C). The switch `around=0` hides everything outside the walls.

searched: No picture of it found in the catalogues searched for the surroundings.

facts.label: In English
facts.value: Garden of Received Grace (承晖园 before 1845)

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a neighbouring imperial or princely garden outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: held by 额驸 景寿 after the death in 1859 of 寿恩固伦公主 (Daoguang's 6th daughter, given 1845) (S1215; S1200); not burned in 1900 (S1200 lead); 1860 fate not stated

facts.label: Where
facts.value: C: north of the NW part of 畅春园 and west of 蔚秀园 (S1200 lead; Malone's sketch labels the plot 'Garden of Prince Ch'ing', its holder from 1894); point by eye, not read; its extent, a circle of 110 m, is assumed

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Today PKU National School of Development; Beijing municipal protected (2011). 1894 to 奕劻. Called 六公主园.; First holder 允礼 (PKU S1216) or 允禧 (S1215): disagreement. Also: AMS 1944 sheet read at px 2080,515, fit rms 95 m (Chengchaoyüan (?)), 359 m from the point used.
